title: Alien
tagline: Long haul in space. Pack a good dinner.
about: A spaceship crew is hunted by a deadly creature that boarded with them.
cue: Serve the mains at the crew dinner, before Kane starts feeling unwell.
faces: Cold sesame noodles with chilli oil and cucumber

Nostromo pork and egg noodle stir-fry
Wok pork, cabbage, carrot and capsicum with egg noodles in oyster sauce
Red velvet dome that bursts with raspberry jam when cut
Strong coffee blended with dark chocolate, milk and ice until frothy.
"Everybody eat, then we check out that transmission. Company orders, nobody likes them."
Serve the mains at the crew dinner, before Kane starts feeling unwell.

No complaints to the cook. Prices subject to change, paid in ship's credit. Offset, issue 2. Form G-79, sheet 2 of 2. 1979. Crew notes: The crew dinner scene at the long table. Jonesy the orange cat. Mother, the ship's computer.
phone:
Nostromo GalleyAlienSeven crew. One very long haul.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersNostromo crew noodlesCold sesame noodles with chilli oil and cucumberHow to make it400g fresh wheat noodles3 tbsp sesame paste2 tbsp soy sauce1 tbsp black vinegar1 tbsp chilli oil1 garlic clove, crushed1 Lebanese cucumber2 spring onionsCook the noodles, then rinse cold and drain.Whisk the sesame paste, soy, vinegar, chilli oil and garlic.Cut the cucumber into matchsticks and slice the spring onion.Toss the noodles through the dressing and top with cucumber and spring onion.Freighter stores crackersSeeded crackers with lemon cream cheese and smoked oystersHow to make it150g cream cheese1 lemon, zested16 seeded crackers170g smoked oysters (2 small tins), drained1 bunch chivescracked pepper, to tasteWhip the cream cheese with the lemon zest.Spread onto the crackers.Top each with a smoked oyster, cracked pepper and snipped chives. Serve straight away.MainsNostromo crew dinnerPork and vegetable noodle stir-fry in bowlsHow to make it500g pork shoulder5 tbsp soy sauce1/4 cabbage2 carrots1 red capsicum1 knob ginger, grated400g fresh egg noodles3 tbsp oyster sauce2 tbsp vegetable oilSlice the pork thin and toss with a little of the soy.Slice the cabbage, carrots and capsicum.Heat the oil in a wok until smoking and stir-fry the pork until browned.Add the vegetables and ginger and stir-fry briefly.Add the noodles, oyster sauce and remaining soy, toss and serve in bowls.Nostromo pork and egg noodle stir-fryWok pork, cabbage, carrot and capsicum with egg noodles in oyster sauceHow to make itPork and vegetable stir-fry with noodles: pork strips, cabbage, carrot, capsicum, soy, oyster sauce and ginger in a smoking wok, piled into bowls.SweetsRed velvet chestburster cakeRed velvet dome that bursts with raspberry jam when cutHow to make it125g butter, soft250g caster sugar2 eggs250g self-raising flour2 tbsp cocoa250ml buttermilk1 tsp white vinegar1 tsp red food colouring150g raspberry jam250g cream cheese200g icing sugarHeat the oven to 170°C and grease a heatproof bowl. Beat the butter and sugar until pale, then beat in the eggs.Fold in the flour, cocoa, buttermilk, vinegar and red colouring.Bake in the bowl until a skewer comes out clean, then cool completely.Turn out and hollow out the centre. Fill with the raspberry jam.Beat the cream cheese with the icing sugar and cover the dome in frosting.DrinksHypersleep wake-up iced mochaStrong coffee blended with dark chocolate, milk and ice until frothy, poured tall and topped with whipped cream and shaved chocolate.How to make it300ml strong brewed coffee100g dark chocolate2 tbsp brown sugar400ml full cream milk2 cups ice1 can whipped creamBrew the coffee. Stir in most of the chocolate, chopped, and the sugar until melted, then cool.Blend with the milk and ice until frothy.Pour into four tall glasses, top with whipped cream and shave the remaining chocolate over.
